name: OurAirports Knowledge
description: Runway, frequency, and navaid detail for airports, matched by IATA/ICAO code

dataSources.purpose: Match an OSM airport to its OurAirports record and render runway, frequency, and navaid detail
dataSources.dataSent: Nothing per-request — the integration mirrors public CSV dumps at startup and matches in memory by IATA/ICAO code
dataSources.dataReceived: Airport identifiers, runway dimensions/surfaces, ATC frequencies, associated navaids, country/region metadata
